name: Vault Custody × Timmy · build ledger
note: One frame per project in the ORDER OF BUILD. Each project's first deliverable is its capsule node. Compiles through slate-compiler (MissionMapDoc) → DispatchPlans; the board never launches, the controller does. Frame state is derived by the viewer from order.execute receipts in the root store (sources.id = order id); frames whose orders were sealed in the frozen fork store name the fork attestation receipt. Edge direction follows the compiler: harness, gate and artifact point INTO the capsule; depends points from the dependency to the dependent; the gate carries the acceptance tests.
